objectives.name: Primary Objective
objectives.text: To assess if treatment with veliparib plus carboplatin and paclitaxel results in improved survival compared to Investigator's choice of standard chemotherapy in Lung Subtype Panel (LSP) positive subjects with metastatic or advanced NSCLC.

provenance.text_snippet: The primary objective of the study is to assess if treatment with veliparib plus carboplatin and paclitaxel results in improved survival compared to Investigator's choice of standard chemotherapy in LSP positive subjects with metastatic or advanced NSCLC.

objectives.name: Secondary Objectives
objectives.text: To assess if treatment with veliparib plus carboplatin and paclitaxel results in improved survival in the entire study population; to compare progression-free survival (PFS) and to compare objective response rate (ORR) between the two treatment arms in LSP positive subjects or in entire study population.

provenance.text_snippet: The secondary objectives of the study are to assess if treatment with veliparib plus carboplatin and paclitaxel results in improved survival compared to Investigator's choice of standard chemotherapy in the entire study population with metastatic or advanced NSCLC; to compare progression-free survival (PFS) and to compare objective response rate (ORR) between the two treatment arms in LSP positive subjects or in the entire study population.

objectives.name: Exploratory Objectives
objectives.text: To compare duration of overall response (DOR), ECOG performance status and Quality of Life (QoL) between the two treatment arms in LSP positive subjects or in the entire study population.

provenance.text_snippet: The tertiary objectives are to compare duration of overall response (DOR), ECOG performance status and Quality of Life (QoL) between the two treatment arms in LSP positive subjects or in the entire study population.

endpoints.name: Overall Survival (OS) in LSP+ Subgroup
endpoints.label: Primary Efficacy Endpoint
endpoints.text: Time from randomization to death from any cause in LSP positive subjects.
endpoints.purpose: To assess the effect on survival in the LSP positive subgroup.

provenance.text_snippet: The primary efficacy analysis will be a comparison of OS distributions between the 120 mg of veliparib BID + carboplatin/paclitaxel and Investigators' choice of platinum therapy groups in LSP + subgroup.

endpoints.name: Progression-Free Survival (PFS) in LSP+ Subgroup
endpoints.label: Secondary Efficacy Endpoint
endpoints.text: Time from randomization to the first documentation of objective tumor progression per RECIST v1.1 or death from any cause, whichever occurs first, in LSP positive subjects.
endpoints.purpose: To assess the effect on disease progression or death in the LSP positive subgroup.

provenance.text_snippet: P values for the secondary efficacy analyses will be subject to multiple comparison adjustments using the fixed sequence test method, with the analyses performed in the following order: progression-free survival (PFS) in LSP+ subgroup, objective response rate (ORR) in LSP+ subgroup, OS in all subjects, PFS in all subjects, ORR in all subjects.

endpoints.name: Objective Response Rate (ORR) in LSP+ Subgroup

endpoints.purpose: To assess tumor response in the LSP positive subgroup.

provenance.text_snippet: P values for the secondary efficacy analyses will be subject to multiple comparison adjustments using the fixed sequence test method, with the analyses performed in the following order: progression-free survival (PFS) in LSP+ subgroup, objective response rate (ORR) in LSP+ subgroup, OS in all subjects, PFS in all subjects, ORR in all subjects.

multiplicity_adjustment.description: A fixed sequence testing procedure will be used for analyses of the primary and secondary efficacy endpoints to control for the family-wise error rate (FWER). If the primary endpoint (OS in LSP+ subgroup) is not statistically significant, significance will not be declared for any secondary endpoints. If it is significant, secondary endpoints are tested in the following order: PFS in LSP+ subgroup, ORR in LSP+ subgroup, OS in all subjects, PFS in all subjects, ORR in all subjects.
multiplicity_adjustment.alpha_allocation: Overall alpha is controlled at 0.025 (one-sided) for the primary endpoint.
multiplicity_adjustment.gatekeeping_strategy: The primary endpoint of OS in the LSP+ subgroup acts as the gatekeeper for all secondary endpoints.

provenance.text_snippet: Fixed sequence testing procedure will be used for analyses of the primary and secondary efficacy endpoints to control for the family-wise error rate (FWER). If veliparib treatment group is not statistically significantly better than the Investigator's choice of platinum therapy group for the primary efficacy endpoint of OS in LSP + subgroup, then statistical significance will not be declared for any of the secondary efficacy endpoints, regardless of the observed P values.

missing_data_handling.method_description: For time-to-event endpoints (OS, PFS), subjects without an event are censored at the date they were last known to be alive or progression-free. For PFS, if a disease progression event occurs after a subject misses two or more consecutive disease assessments, the subject's data will be censored at the last disease progression assessment prior to the missing assessments.

provenance.text_snippet: However, if a disease progression event occurs after a subject misses two or more consecutive disease assessments, then this subject's data will be censored at the last disease progression assessment prior to the missing disease assessments.
